text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... I need... to train more!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Checking in with Mejiro McQueen, I see
that she is pushing herself
especially hard
today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I cannot afford to let myself disgrace the
Mejiro name any further.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Do I find it hard to channel strength
into
my legs?" I don't think so!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She appears to be incredibly flustered by
something, and it is
certainly affecting her
running ability.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Wh-what's this? My entire body is...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her body wobbles a bit before crumbling
to the ground.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After an examination at the Academy
infirmary, it appears she is
suffering from a
mild case of anemia.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The root cause appears to be a lack of
nutritional intake. Is she
actually eating
properly?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
McQueen! I heard you collapsed! Are you
all—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Oh, uh... Sorry!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Um, hello. I'm Mejiro Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Are you McQueen's trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I see...
but you still went out of your way
to help her, right? Thank
you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Do you know why she ended up collapsing
out there?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell Mejiro Ryan everything I heard from
the infirmary staff.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Anemia caused by a lack of nutrients... I
see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I thought something was off leading up to
her tryout race. I really
should've spoken
to her...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. But I wasn't able to do anything for
her...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You've probably figured it out already,
but I'm also a member of the
Mejiro family.
We're not siblings, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
McQueen and I grew up on the estate
together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
She's always taken her future objectives
real seriously; to the point
where I think
she pushes herself way too hard
sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I wish she'd realize she's perfect just
the
way she is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Oh, shoot! I need to go!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Sorry for barging in. Please excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: And, um... please take care of McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Entrusting me with her family, Mejiro Ryan
hurries off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Shortly after, Mejiro McQueen wakes up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
So that's what happened... Losing
consciousness in the middle of
training...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I'm very sorry for causing you so much
trouble, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I'm feeling right as rain now!
I should get
back to traini—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gurgle...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Eek!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
O-of course I am! A Mejiro always has her
day planned out perfectly,
and that
includes the consumption of three
nutritious meals!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Though with the tryouts, I may have
decreased the amount I ate
during those
meals...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My collapse had nothing to do with my
eating habits! I simply haven't
been
training hard enough!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: What? Um, I suppose that's fine...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: McQueen passes over her dietary notes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she is indeed following this plan, then
she's only getting the bare minimum in
required nutrition.
This could be why she's having strength
issues.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Well? As I said,
this should be plenty good
enough.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Wh-what? Really?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I suppose I shouldn't feel the need to
hide
anything from you, given
how much you've
been looking out for me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Very well.
The truth of the matter is that I
have a good reason for
following this plan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: It's just that... You see...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I have a tendency to gain weight easily.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It can even happen just by following a
normal dietary plan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't possibly allow anyone to see a
flabby Mejiro belly at the
tryouts!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
So that's why I thought it best to limit
myself...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
But in the end, I had my priorities
backwards.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It seems I have some reflection to do. I
apologize again for all the
trouble I've
caused you today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With those words, Mejiro McQueen makes
her way to the doors of the
infirmary.
